en: An old monochrome postcard depicting a large castle complex with a central round tower topped by a lantern and dome, flanked by multi‑storey wings with steep gabled roofs and many small dormer windows. The façade looks worn and slightly dilapidated. Printed German captions in red at the top identify the location, and a small vertical inscription along the left edge gives the publisher and year.
